statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has symptoms consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a recent history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The service is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to assess the efficacy of current rate-control therapy
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
